pay_cost_of_living_007.answer: 2% effective July 1, 2005 (except schedule B12); 6.5% effective July 1, 2006 (3.5% on 7th paycheck, 6.5% on others). COLA from State determines sabbatical leave quota.
pay_cost_of_living_007.evidence: The 2002-2003 salary schedules shall be increased by 2% effective July 1, 2005. / The 2006-2007 salary schedule increase of 6.5% shall be implemented by increasing the seventh pay check over the final 2005-2006 schedule 3.5% and by increasing all remaining paychecks over the final 2005-2006 schedule by 6.5%. / The percentage of sabbatical leaves granted for a school year shall be the same as the net COLA percentage increase that the District received from the State in the prior year.
